In the morning he wrote a reply, corked it tight, and let the next tide carry it out past the rocks.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡。街灯把空旷的马路照成一条безcolor的河，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，尾灯像一粒红色的星。便利店亮着，店员靠在柜台后打盹。送奶车停在巷口，玻璃瓶轻轻碰撞。天边泛起一层极淡的青灰，像有人在黑布上倒了半杯清水。风是凉的，带着夜里残存的湿气。这座城市在最安静的时刻里，悄悄积蓄着又一个白天的喧嚣。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n• It's like standing in a line and asking the person ahead how many people are in front, and they ask the next person, and so on.\n• It has to stop somewhere, so there's always a simple case that answers without asking again."}
